_comment: Server-side model metadata catalog. Non-secret by design - the Settings API only ever returns this metadata plus a boolean 'available' per entry, never credentials. Providers/keys stay in .env. The registry (model_router.resolve_module) reads capability compatibility from this file and config/model_routing.json.

text_generation.description: Chat, summarization, drafting, scoring, classification, synthesis

deepseek-chat.notes: Cheap default backend. API key from DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (.env).

gpt-5.6-luna.notes: Cheap OpenAI tier. Key from OPENAI_API_KEY; id overridable by OPENAI_MODEL_LUNA.

gpt-5.6-terra.notes: Medium OpenAI tier. Key from OPENAI_API_KEY; id overridable by OPENAI_MODEL_TERRA.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: High/strategic OpenAI tier. Key from OPENAI_API_KEY; id overridable by OPENAI_MODEL_SOL.

text-embedding-3-small.notes: Embedding model for the FAISS knowledge index. Key from OPENAI_API_KEY.

gemini-3-pro-image.notes: Default image model ('Nano Banana', pro 3.1 tier). Token from gemini-image/token.env or GEMINI_API_KEY.

imagen-4.0.notes: Used only when true aspect-ratio control is needed.

whisper-1.notes: Cloud transcription. Managed by meeting-recorder/config.json engine=openai.

gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Cloud transcription with speaker labels. meeting-recorder config key gemini_model.
